title: Contrast clue: gregarious
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: Unlike his usually reserved brother, Adi was gregarious and quickly began conversations with everyone at the camp. What does “gregarious” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Starting conversations with everyone and the contrast with reserved both indicate sociability.
choice_rationales.B: The sentence does not describe caution.
choice_rationales.C: Silent conflicts with beginning many conversations.
choice_rationales.D: No contest or comparison of ability is mentioned.

parts.hint: Use both the word “Unlike” and Adi’s behaviour.
parts.correct_explanation: “Unlike ... reserved” creates a contrast, and starting conversations with everyone confirms that gregarious means sociable.
